decisions.reason: As a niche line relatively distant from the main portfolio and only weakly evidenced compared with the other launches, it is the most likely to fall short of the firm's rising aspirations and be cut so resources can return to core LED development.

This product line fits the firm's industrial lighting capabilities and the 2019 LED replacement-kit extension suggests satisfactory results, so a large expanding firm with R&D slack would likely retain it.

A relaunched popular task light close to the established offer is likely performing at least adequately against aspirations, giving management little reason to search for an alternative use of the resources.

The office luminaire is close to the core business, but as a newer single-product launch without visible follow-on investment it remains a borderline candidate that is still more likely to be carried than dropped in an expanding firm.
This premium pendant line is near the firm's established offer and the multi-model commitment points to expected acceptable performance, so organizational slack and strategic fit favor keeping it.
